title: a CLAUDE.md with an @AGENTS.md import line is left alone, only AGENTS.md changes
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). `CLAUDE.md` is the single line `@AGENTS.md`, so Claude Code already reads the block through the import. The command creates `AGENTS.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` stays byte for byte (and is not in the preview). The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
